state.name: Connecticut
state.agency_full: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

focus_areas.name: Site Remediation
focus_areas.description: Cleanup standards, regulatory frameworks, licensed professional programs, voluntary remediation, and document portals.

focus_areas.name: Stormwater
focus_areas.description: Permits and guidance for municipal, construction, and industrial stormwater, plus stormwater quality resources.

focus_areas.name: Site Assessment
focus_areas.description: Site characterization guidance, environmental assessment resources, database search tools, and brownfield programs.

recent_updates.title: Release-Based Cleanup Regs (RBCRs) — Effective
recent_updates.description: RBCRs took effect March 1, 2026, replacing the CT Property Transfer Act with a release-based reporting and cleanup system.

recent_updates.title: MS4 General Permit — Draft Reissuance
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP issued a Notice of Tentative Determination to reissue the MS4 General Permit; public comment period opened March 25, 2025.

recent_updates.title: REACT Portal Launch
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP's new Release, Environmental Assessment, and Cleanup Tracker (REACT) portal is live for document uploads and tracking as of early 2026.

recent_updates.title: Release Remediation Closure Report Guide — Published
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP replaced its Verification Report Guidance Document with updated guidance for documenting release remediation closure and compliance across cleanup programs.

documents.title: Release-Based Cleanup Regulations (RBCRs) — Main Page
documents.description: The new CT cleanup regulatory framework effective March 1, 2026. Replaces the Property Transfer Act. Describes requirements to report, characterize, and remediate releases. Incorporates the RSRs.

documents.title: Environmental Cleanup — REACT Portal & Overview
documents.description: CT DEEP's Environmental Cleanup program page, including the new REACT (Release, Environmental Assessment, and Cleanup Tracker) portal for document submission and property tracking.

documents.title: Technical Impracticability (TI) Variance
documents.description: Remedial option under the RSRs when NAPL cannot be contained or removed per RSR requirements and remediation has been conducted to the extent technically practicable.

documents.title: Engineered Controls (ECs) — Overview
documents.description: Permanent physical structures used to isolate pollutants that cannot meet RSR direct cleanup criteria. Application requirements, financial assurance forms, and completion statements available here.

documents.title: Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Program
documents.description: Overview of the CT LEP licensure system. LEPs verify site investigations and remediation under the RSRs/RBCRs. Includes program description, LEP roster link, exam applications, and renewal forms.

documents.title: LEP Verifications — Forms & Instructions
documents.description: LEP Verification Forms (Forms III and IV, 133x, Brownfields, RCRA) and instructions. Required for submitting a verification that a site has been remediated per RSRs or RBCRs.

documents.title: Release Remediation Closure Report Guide
documents.description: CT DEEP guidance for documenting closure after remediation or when characterization demonstrates that remediation is unnecessary. Covers conceptual site models, demonstrations of RBCR compliance, multiple releases, and program-specific closure reporting for release-based cleanup, property transfer, voluntary remediation, brownfields, and RCRA programs.

documents.title: Voluntary Remediation Programs — Overview
documents.description: Overview of CT DEEP's voluntary remediation programs, including program options for investigating and remediating contaminated property under LEP oversight.

documents.title: Remediation Forms — Central Repository
documents.description: Master forms page for CT DEEP Remediation Division: ECAF, Engineered Control variance forms, LEP verification forms, monitoring status forms, and APS/criteria approval requests.

documents.title: MS4 General Permit — Current (Effective Oct 1, 2023)
documents.description: General Permit for Discharge of Stormwater from Small Municipal Separate Storm Sewer Systems (MS4). This permit is currently expired; users should review the reissuance information on the overview page for its current standing. Requires municipalities, public universities, and state/federal facilities to implement six Minimum Control Measures.

documents.title: MS4 General Permit — 2025 Draft Reissuance
documents.description: Draft MS4 General Permit issued March 2025 for public comment. Notice of Tentative Determination and Fact Sheet available. Permit administratively extended while DEEP reviews comments.

documents.title: Construction Stormwater General Permit (CGP)
documents.description: Required for construction sites disturbing 1+ acres. Requires a Stormwater Pollution Control Plan (SPCP). Locally Approvable projects (1–5 acres) may not need to register with DEEP directly if local approval applies. Effective January 1, 2026.

documents.title: CT Guidelines for Soil Erosion and Sediment Control (2023)
documents.description: Comprehensive guidance for E&S control on construction sites. Referenced in the CGP and required by municipal land-use approvals. Updated in 2023 with new LID integration and construction phasing requirements.

documents.title: Industrial Stormwater General Permit (IGP)
documents.description: NPDES General Permit for Discharge of Stormwater Associated with Industrial Activity. Covers a wide range of industrial sectors; requires Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans, monitoring, and benchmarks.

documents.title: CT Stormwater Quality Manual
documents.description: Primary guidance for post-construction stormwater management in CT. Covers LID site design, BMP selection, water quality volume calculations (updated to 1.3" design storm), and pollutant load reduction targets.

documents.title: CT Stormwater Quality Manual - Online Interactive Version
documents.description: UConn NEMO-hosted interactive version of the CT Stormwater Quality Manual, with searchable chapters, design tools, and workflow checklists for LID and BMP design.

documents.title: Stormwater — CT DEEP Main Page
documents.description: Central landing page for all CT DEEP stormwater programs including MS4, construction, and industrial permits. Access to permit documents, annual report templates, and contact information.

documents.title: Site Characterization Guidance — DEEP Guidance Page
documents.description: CT DEEP landing page for site cleanup and characterization guidance documents, including links to the SCGD, expedited site assessment guidance, and supplemental technical documents.

documents.title: REACT — Release, Environmental Assessment & Cleanup Tracker
documents.description: CT DEEP's new online portal for searching properties with known releases, tracking cleanup progress, and submitting environmental documents. Replaces the legacy Online Document Search Portal for post-February 2026 submissions.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: LEP Program — Overview for Site Assessment
documents.description: Licensed Environmental Professionals (LEPs) in CT are required to supervise Phase II investigations and verify site conditions under the RSRs and RBCRs. Includes LEP roster and audit program information.

documents.title: Brownfields Program — Main Page
documents.description: CT DEEP Brownfields Program overview, covering eligibility, available programs (VRP, BRWP, BEP), LEP requirements, and liability protections for prospective purchasers and municipalities.

documents.title: Release-Based Cleanup Regulations — Official Regulatory Text
documents.description: Official Connecticut eRegulations text for the Release-Based Cleanup Regulations in RCSA sections 22a-134tt-1 through 22a-134tt-13. Provides the controlling requirements for reporting, characterizing, remediating, and closing releases.

documents.title: RBCR Cleanup Standards
documents.description: CT DEEP guidance on selecting and applying RBCR soil and groundwater cleanup standards. Covers groundwater classifications, land use, sensitive receptors, Direct Exposure Criteria, Pollutant Mobility Criteria, and requirements for determining when cleanup is complete.

documents.title: RBCR Compliance Measures and Variances
documents.description: Overview of methods for demonstrating compliance with the RBCRs, including background concentrations, numeric criteria, statistical demonstrations, institutional controls, Environmental Use Restrictions, stewardship permits, engineered controls, and variances.

documents.title: RBCR Release Tiers
documents.description: Explains Connecticut's risk-based release tier system, including Tier 1A, Tier 1B, Tier 2, and Tier 3 classifications, DEEP and LEP oversight, tier assignment and reassignment, characterization report submission, and applicable fees.

documents.title: Significant Existing Releases and Immediate Actions
documents.description: Requirements for historical releases that present increased short-term risks to human health or the environment. Covers Significant Existing Release reporting, Immediate Actions, drinking-water-well impacts, exposure controls, response deadlines, and transition to cleanup under the RBCRs.

documents.title: REACT Resources and Instructions
documents.description: Instructions and training resources for using REACT, including account creation, authenticated-user functions, property searches, case management, document uploads, and quick property search guidance.

documents.title: Environmental Use Restrictions (EURs)
documents.description: Central CT DEEP resource for Environmental Use Restrictions, including recorded restrictions, Certificates of Title, land-record research, inspection and reporting obligations, permitted activities, releases, and related forms.

documents.title: Environmental Cleanup Comprehensive Map Viewer
documents.description: Interactive CT DEEP ArcGIS application for viewing mapped information associated with environmental cleanup properties and releases. Supports location-based records review, preliminary site research, and environmental due diligence.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances (PFAS)
documents.description: CT DEEP's central PFAS resource covering environmental behavior, potential sources, and pathways through soil, groundwater, surface water, air, wastewater, firefighting foam, and waste-management systems, along with Connecticut response information.

documents.title: Industrial Stormwater SWPPP Template
documents.description: Downloadable CT DEEP framework for preparing a Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan under the current Industrial Stormwater General Permit. Provides an editable structure for documenting facility controls, monitoring, inspections, and permit compliance.

documents.title: Contaminated or Potentially Contaminated Sites
documents.description: Searchable and downloadable Connecticut dataset of properties identified through DEEP records as contaminated or potentially contaminated. The dataset is generated from environmental cleanup information maintained in REACT.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: CT DEEP Document eSearch
documents.description: CT DEEP portal for searching historical environmental filings and supporting documents, including remediation records submitted before the February 2026 transition to REACT.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Underground Storage Tanks — Facility and Tank Details
documents.description: Searchable Connecticut dataset with current and historical commercial underground storage tank facility and tank details, including registered systems that remain in use and systems no longer active.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Releases from Federally Regulated Underground Storage Tank Systems
documents.description: Searchable Connecticut dataset of releases from federally regulated underground storage tank systems reported by CT DEEP to EPA, including facility, case, substance, and discovery information.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Connecticut Brownfields Inventory
documents.description: CT DEEP inventory of known brownfield properties and available information about municipal, state, and federal brownfield program involvement.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection
